text_block_list.text:
"As cherry blossom petals dance through 
the sky, and the green of young buds 
begins to peek out—"

The day of the Satsuki Sho. When I headed 
to the venue with Sakura Laurel, the 
stands were packed with spectators.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The excitement is insane...! Even though 
the race hasn't even started yet...
choice_data_list:
So this is the Classic Triple Crown 
road...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: これがクラシック三冠路線……！
choice_data_list_en: So this is the Classic Triple Crown trail...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I managed to slide in too. Right 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Biwa Hayahide's sister is running 
this year, right!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right, exactly! BNW's race last year was 
amazing, so everyone's got high hopes for 
her sister too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
! I see, so that's another kind of 
expectation people have for Brian-chan.
choice_data_list:
Because people especially believe what 
they see with their own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see. You saw Hayahide-chan, believed in 
her strength, and also placed your faith 
in her sister, Brian-chan.
choice_data_list: ヒトは自分の見たものを、特に信じるから
choice_data_list_en: People tend to believe what they see with their own eyes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! I'll watch closely with my own two 
eyes! I'll see it through to the end!"
choice_data_list: 俺たちも“憧れの走り”の強さを確かめよう
私たちも“憧れの走り”の強さを確かめよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's test the strength of that 'running style we admire' ourselves.
Let's see for ourselves the strength of that "run we've dreamed of."

text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the Satsuki Sho 
paddock.

Her condition just happened to be good 
this time, allowing Sakura Laurel to enter 
the Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list:
(But there's no denying the ticking time 
bomb in my legs.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...If I feel it's dangerous to push myself 
any further while running, I will 
prioritize safety, even if it means 
slowing down.
choice_data_list: （けど脚に爆弾がある事実は否めない）
choice_data_list_en: (Still, there's no denying the ticking time bomb in her leg.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, right up until the very end, as 
much as I can... No, I'm going to run with 
everything I've got!
choice_data_list: Leave the post-race care to me.

text_block_list.text:
Once the decision to enter this race was 
made, I had already made arrangements with 
the hospital just in case.
choice_data_list: レース後の処置は任せて
choice_data_list_en: Leave the post-race care to me.

text_block_list.text:
And so, I sent Sakura Laurel off to the 
paddock for the Satsuki Sho—
